label: Incident B
alert: checkout-api: Timeout acquiring a database connection (timeout=3000ms). HTTP 5xx is elevated. Investigate the cause and explain what distinguishes it from other plausible causes.
provenance: Synthetic evidence, authored for this controlled exercise. These records were not captured from a customer or a running cluster. Times and values form a consistent scenario, not a production benchmark.

evidence.title: Alert and timeline
evidence.content:
Environment: checkout-prod. Three application pods, one PostgreSQL cluster.
13:55 release r184 and database migration 087 began; complete at 13:57.
13:58 HTTP p95 rose from 140ms to 8200ms; 5xx rose sharply at 14:00.
14:00 error: Timeout acquiring a database connection (timeout=3000ms).
Observation window: 13:45-14:05 UTC. Billing database-query latency alert fired at 13:59.

evidence.title: Application telemetry
evidence.content:
Per-pod averages over 5-minute windows:
window,requests_per_second,pool_limit,pool_checked_out,pool_waiters,pool_acquire_p95_ms,db_query_p95_ms
13:45,180,40,13,0,4,65
13:50,182,40,13,0,4,66
14:00,181,40,40,58,3000,4900
14:05,179,40,40,62,3000,5100
All three pods show the same transition. Request rate has no step change. Long-running requests hold their connections until query completion; connections are returned afterward.
